title: How often should I service my AC in Al Waha Community?
desc: For many residential systems, servicing every 3 to 6 months is a practical schedule. Units used heavily may need more frequent attention.

title: Why is my AC cooling one room but not another?
desc: Uneven cooling can happen because of blocked filters, restricted ducts, poor airflow, thermostat settings or problems with the cooling system.

title: How much does AC repair cost in Al Waha Community?
desc: The cost depends on the AC type, fault, required parts and repair work. An inspection helps determine the actual problem before repair.

title: Can you repair AC water leakage?
desc:
Yes, we repair all common issues, including:
  • Blocked drain line
  • Frozen evaporator coil
  • Dirty filter
  • Drainage problems

title: When does an AC need a gas refill?
desc: A gas refill is needed only when refrigerant is low. The technician should first check for a refrigerant leak before adding gas.

title: Does AC cleaning help with bad smells?
desc: Yes, cleaning filters, coils and drainage areas can remove dust, moisture and buildup that often cause unpleasant AC smells.

title: Can I get same-day AC repair in Al Waha Community?
desc: Same-day AC Repair may be available depending on technician schedules, location and the type of fault.

title: What is checked during AC maintenance?
desc:
A maintenance visit may include:
  • Filter cleaning
  • Coil inspection
  • Drain line checking
  • Thermostat testing
  • Cooling performance testing

title: Which AC brands do you service?
desc: Our technicians work with major brands such as Daikin, LG, Samsung, Carrier, Mitsubishi, O General, York, Gree, Panasonic and others.

title: Why does my AC make a buzzing sound?
desc: Buzzing may come from loose electrical parts, fan problems, vibration or worn components. An inspection can identify the source.

title: How can I reduce my AC electricity consumption?
desc: Keep filters clean, maintain good airflow, avoid very low thermostat settings and schedule regular AC maintenance.

title: Is an Annual Maintenance Contract useful?
desc: Yes, an AMC provides planned servicing and preventive checks. It can help identify faults earlier and reduce unexpected repair requirements.

title: Why is my AC running but the room is still warm?
desc: Common causes include low refrigerant, dirty filters, restricted airflow, thermostat faults or compressor problems. An inspection can identify the exact cause.

title: Should I repair or replace an old AC?
desc: Repair may make sense when the fault is minor. If the unit has repeated major failures or expensive component problems, replacement may be worth considering.

title: How do I book AC service in Al Waha Community?
desc: Share your location, AC problem and preferred appointment time with FAJ Technical Services L.L.C. The team can arrange a suitable service visit.
